{{greeting}}

Thanks for giving bingd a shot.

The app was inspired by Beli, which changed the way I experienced
restaurants. I went from someone who liked eating out occasionally to
someone who ranked every restaurant, compared lists with friends, and
actively looked for the next place to try.

I built bingd because I think movies and TV are missing that same loop,
one that can make the post-watch experience almost as exciting as the
watch itself. Rank your latest binge to see where it lands, comment on
and save your friends' watches, and find your next title with better
recommendations.

If you want to suggest a feature, find something confusing, or just want
to say hi, hit reply. It comes straight to me.

bingd is more fun with friends, so here's your invite link
(https://bingd.app/i/{{inviteToken}}). And if you want to see what I'm
watching, follow me on bingd (https://bingd.app/u/saisurajkan).

Happy binging,
Suraj
